title: Chapter 213: Battle Against Anna'S Clone
content:
Chapter 213: Battle Against Anna'S Clone

Ayub and Wang Shuo were on both sides of Gong Zheng to prevent the boss from destroying the crossbow cart in the back.

Gong Zheng took the initiative and jumped to Anna's side with a move of Taishan pressure.

The petrification skill was activated, and the protective shield surrounded him.

Although the dizziness lasted only a short second, it was enough for the bronze crossbow cart to start.

Immediately, ten bronze spears flew out and pierced directly into the body of Anna's clone.

The spears that penetrated the body revealed half of the spear body.

"-1600"

...

The ten spears caused a total of 16,000 damage, which shocked Wang Shuo.

"Ah!"

A terrifying howl sounded.

Wang Shuo and the other two standing next to Anna were affected by the "Horrible Howl" skill and had splitting headaches.

Nana used the bone spur tentacles behind her to pull out the bronze spears one by one.

She also showed a painful expression on her face, but the hole in her chest healed at a speed visible to the naked eye.

By the time Wang Shuo and the others came to their senses, her body was already intact.

She had only lost some health points, but had not recovered.

Wang Shuo frowned, stepped forward, and prepared to attack.

Ayub and Gong Zheng also immediately took action and joined the battle.

The bone spurs behind Anna blocked all the attacks of Wang Shuo and the other two, and even launched a fierce counterattack.

It was Wang Shuo and the other two who were in a hurry.

After a delay, the bronze crossbow cart reloaded the spears.

Wang Shuo found the right time and launched the "iron chain binding".

Unexpectedly, Anna also launched the "spider silk entanglement".

The four of them were trapped in place.

On Li Jianguo's side, only four bronze crossbow carts could aim at Anna.

"Swoosh"

Four spears shot out, consuming another 6,400 points of Anna's health.

Anna quickly broke free from the restraints, but Wang Shuo and the other two were not so powerful.

She was still tied in place.

Anna also found that the bronze crossbow cart posed the greatest threat to her.

So he jumped over the three people and started to slaughter the soldiers of the crossbow battalion.

"Go."

Wang Shuo turned back with difficulty and shouted.

Ordinary soldiers were no match for Anna, and they couldn't even slow her down.

A bone spur pierced the soldier's chest, and several other bone spurs made up for it.

He really killed a little friend.

He killed three of them in one encounter.

These soldiers were Wang Shuo's elite troops, and Wang Shuo's heart was bleeding.

While paying attention to the battlefield, Wang Shuo accelerated to break free from the spider silk.

30 seconds later, Gong Zheng was the first to break free, and used another move of "Taishan Pressing the Top" to entangle Anna.

It took Wang Shuo and Ayub a minute to break free.

The three of them joined forces again to fight the enemy.

Anna turned on the spider form.

Instantly transformed into a light spider.

It was really three heroes fighting one spider.

The little giant Gong Zheng took the damage from the front, while Ayub and Wang Shuo were responsible for the side attack.

The battle situation was deadlocked.

Li Jianguo gathered the remaining soldiers. Three bronze crossbow carts were directly destroyed and seven soldiers died.

After adjusting his position, he set up the crossbow cart again, but he didn't have time to load the spear.

Anna rushed over again, and Li Jianguo had to lead people to avoid Anna's attack again.

The battlefield was in chaos, and a group of people were chased everywhere.

At this moment, Ayub leaped over the path Anna was about to pass, and performed "Purple Thunder Breaking Sky Strike" in the air.

A purple thunder fell from the sky, attached to the Qinglong Sword, and chopped it out with a purple light.

"-1200"

A huge red number floated above Anna's head, and at the same time, electric arcs were emitting from her body.

Anna was in pain and screamed again. At the same time, eight bone spurs rushed towards Ayub who fell from the sky.

Ayub was in mid-air and was affected by Anna's skills. He was unable to react and was pierced directly by eight spears.

"No!"
